5419.title: Desktop Home mounts compact-only recent content
5419.rootCauseOneLine: The desktop branch of RootComposeSecondaryContent mounts compactScrollContent, including the CSS-hidden, unbounded recent-thread list.
5419.proposedFix: Remove compactScrollContent from the desktop layout branch; retain compact rendering and verify desktop-to-compact-to-desktop transitions.
5419.caveats: DOM regression at the production layout boundary; not a full browser profile. The original total element counts and content-script timings were not reproduced. Mobile list capping or virtualization remains outside this minimal desktop fix.
